newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak meets Hariri on Mideast, potatoes.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak meets Hariri on Mideast, potatoes.

text.p: Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Cairo on Thursday at the start of a hastily arranged visit to Egypt.
Official sources in Egypt said they would discuss the crisis in Arab-Israeli relations over Jerusalem and a bilateral dispute over Egyptian potato exports to Lebanon.
Hariri also wants to coordinate with Egypt on association agreements between Arab states and the European Union, added official sources in Beirut.
Lebanon has angered Egypt by banning imports of Egyptian potatoes to protect home-grown potatoes. Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa said this week countermeasures might be in order.
Later on Thursday Mubarak will meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara, official sources said.
